deploy._comment: No startCommand on purpose. Railway does NOT run it through a shell, so `$PORT` arrives at uvicorn as the literal string and the container crash-loops with 'Invalid value for --port'. The Dockerfile's CMD already uses `sh -c`, which expands ${PORT} and ${WEB_CONCURRENCY} correctly on Railway and falls back to 8080/1 under docker-compose — one source of truth for how this service starts.
